niche.habitat: Machine worlds, artificial ecologies, and newly seeded planets under Terrestrial caretakers, often in closed-loop or terraformed zones.
niche.diet: Highly modular; shifts between aerobic, anaerobic, and chemoautotrophic modes based on environmental availability.
niche.active: Task-dependent, often synchronized with caretaker directives or ecological maintenance cycles.

body: Modular, chimeric bio-fabrication shifts between forms on command, allowing rapid niche switching in closed-loop or terraformed environments. Dermal gas-exchange cultures replace lungs, maximizing surface area for efficient oxygen and CO₂ cycling in low-flow atmospheres.

chains.trait: Modular, chimeric bio-fabrication shifting between forms on command
links: Gravital apathy and pity led to extensive genetic splicing, turning biology into a programmable substrate
Closed-loop ark systems demanded near-perfect nutrient recycling across zoned biomes
Forced mechanical circulation prevents gas stratification, requiring organisms that actively filter and convert waste

skill.effect: Splices subject genomes to purify toxins or heal allies, drawing on stored reserves to restore 8 health points and grant temporary resistance to environmental hazards.

chains.weakness: High metabolic cost during rapid niche-switching leaves them vulnerable to starvation, imposing disadvantage on strength checks until they consume nutrients.
observe: See them shift from caretaker to consumer mid-breath
Tissues bloom and wither like controlled flora in the forced airflow
Polydactyl hands and filter-gills operate in seamless, rhythmic succession

journal.en: They are the galaxy's living recycling plant.

plausibility.summary: Morphing is Gravital/Asteromorph germline programming and epigenetic gates, not instant natural selection; shift time scale hours to days with high calorie cost (contradicts F17 'instant' unless labeled highly speculative); Symbiotic Weave as curated microbiome/chimeric organoids, not on-the-fly whole-body rewrite.

links: Tissue rapidly reorganizes into niche-specific forms
Closed-loop life support mandates near-perfect mass conservation

relations.note: Subjects pump closed-loop gas-exchange cultures and modular biomass; Terrestrials provide 1G structural management and regulatory oversight. A mutualistic loop of flesh and gravity. -> Skill: 'Bio-infrastructure sync' (Social)

Subjects use open modular splicing for rapid niche switching; Gravitals use closed-loop quantum cores for static stability. Opposite adaptability strategies under identical biochemical roots. -> Skill: 'Metabolic flexibility' (Engage)

temperament: Adaptable and compliant, they thrive as functional components of engineered ecosystems rather than independent agents.
secrets: Can temporarily fuse dermal cultures into dense filtration mats, purifying toxic atmospheres or creating breathable micro-environments for allies.
moments: Drifting through a methane-ocean habitat, they reshape their limbs into paddle-like appendages and deploy gas-exchange membranes to harvest dissolved volatiles, their bodies shifting seamlessly between aquatic and aerial morphs.
